analogy.rationale: XIAP is an anti-apoptotic protein that inhibits caspases and modulates NF-kB signaling; its inhibition is expected to have subtle transcriptional effects in these cell lines, so the response should be weak. The most related classes are those touching apoptosis/proteostasis pathways, but even these share only limited downstream transcriptional overlap.
